mapper.sql: id, username, password, name, gender, image, entrydate, stu_id, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: select s.id, s.username, s.name, s.gender, s.image, s.entrydate, s.stu_id, s.class_id, ac.class_name from student s join administrative_class ac on ac.id = s.class_id where s.id = #{id}

select s.id, s.stu_id as studentNo, s.name, s.gender, ac.class_name as className, s.image from student s left join administrative_class ac on ac.id = s.class_id
and s.stu_id
= #{keyword} like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
and s.name
= #{keyword} like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
order by s.stu_id
